name: GatherHQ
long_description:
Gather's long horizon agent serves enterprise GTM teams by continually interviewing real buyers and turning what it learned into content that drives pipeline and simulations that predict customer behavior.

More than 65 enterprise marketing teams, including Envoy, Eclypsium, Cover Genius, Fortinet, CoStar, Bagel Brands, and Family Express, use Gather to continually fight AI slop and create original on-brand, third-party validated thought leadership, reports, ebooks, and campaign content.

The value of that research compounds. Every interview adds to a foundation of quantitative, qualitative, and voice data from over 300,000 real interviews across customers, with thousands added monthly. Our models use that understanding to predict how buyers will respond to messaging, pricing, and market shifts. Each answer includes supporting evidence and a confidence level. When confidence is low, Gather automatically runs new research.

Gather starts by replacing research firms and content agencies, and we aspire to build the real-time customer understanding layer that enterprises will use to drive decisions.

Built by the team that created Cooliris (acquired by Yahoo) and Pulse (acquired by Gartner), and ran Gartner Peer Insights.

launches.title: GatherHQ: An API for how buyers think (built for agents and teams)
launches.tagline: AI that interviews real people and builds living models agents (and humans) can query.
launches.body:
GatherHQ interviews real buyers, turns their insights into content, and builds a living simulation of your market that AI agents (and teams) can keep querying. We’ve conducted 250,000+ interviews and serve 60 enterprise customers.

<https://youtu.be/PuxzsvVnNGY>

**Intro**

We’re Mayank, Anand, and Jay. We previously built PulseQ&A (acquired by Gartner), and Cooliris (acquired by Yahoo!). Now we’re building GatherHQ: **an API for how buyers think.**

**Search and research are foundational tools for the agentic workforce.**

Search and research are foundational tools for AI agents. Search finds existing knowledge. Research generates new evidence, tests assumptions, and answers questions that haven’t been answered yet.

GatherHQ is building the infrastructure for agentic research. We connect existing customer knowledge, real interviews, and living buyer models so agents can investigate questions, learn from people, and act on the evidence.

Today, that infrastructure helps marketing, product, and insights teams:

* Differentiate your messaging, positioning, and pricing based on what resonates with buyers
* Drive revenue and growth with original content moving PR, AEO, and SEO
* Increase ROAS with simulations before ads go live
* Prioritize roadmaps with confidence 10X faster insights for product and insights teams
* Beat competitors with a continuous pulse on what buyers want

As agents take on more work, research becomes continuous, embedded in the workflow, and invisible.

**GatherHQ makes research a tool agents can call.**

1. **Query what’s already known.** GatherHQ makes customer calls, surveys, and existing research accessible to your team and agents. Years of customer knowledge become immediately useful.
2. **Generate new evidence.** When knowledge is missing, GatherHQ’s AI researcher designs a study, recruits your audience, and conducts adaptive interviews with real people. With access to 65 million people, it delivers quantitative and qualitative insights in days.
3. **Build understanding that compounds.** Every interview strengthens a living model of your buyers. Teams and agents can query that model and simulate responses to new pricing, messaging, and product ideas in minutes. Fresh interviews keep it grounded.

**Built for agents. Already serving teams.**

Marketing, product, and insights teams use GatherHQ today to answer critical questions and move faster. They access that research through GatherHQ and Emma in Slack. Agents access the same infrastructure through the API.

The research also becomes content: whitepapers, infographics, and social posts grounded in real quotes and data, helping teams turn customer understanding into demand.

**Powering insights for 60+ enterprises**

Our enterprise customers include Datadog, Fortinet, SailPoint, Envoy, Staples, Invoca, CloudBolt, and Cover Genius. Recent insights we’ve published include:

* **1,392 consumers across seven countries** for Cover Genius.
* **1,076 business leaders** for Envoy.
* **302 IT decision-makers** for CloudBolt.

All completed in days. See the work: [Cover Genius](https://covergenius.com/resources/reports/2026-embedded-protection-report/) · [CloudBolt](https://www.cloudbolt.io/cii-report-the-mass-exodus-that-never-was/) · [Invoca](https://www.invoca.com/reports/b2c-buyer-experience-report-2026)

**Where this goes**

Research becomes continuous, embedded in the workflow, and invisible. Teams and agents get the customer understanding they need, when a decision calls for it. We’re building the infrastructure that makes that possible. An API for how people think… starting with buyers.

**What would you ask your buyers?**

[Get started with GatherHQ](https://www.gatherhq.com)

Mayank, Anand & Jay
